Name: AI_ATTACK_PARAM_ST
Description: Defines how the AI chooses and uses an attack. Each row describes one attack of an attack table: its distances, angles, selection rates and follow-up (derived) attacks.

Fields.Name: Attack Table ID
Fields.Description: ID of the attack table this row belongs to.

Fields.Name: Attack ID
Fields.Description: ID of the attack this row describes.

Fields.Name: Success Distance
Fields.Description: Distance within which the attack is judged as successful. Likely in metres.

Fields.Name: Turn Time Before Attack
Fields.Description: Time spent turning towards the target before the attack starts. Likely in seconds.

Fields.Name: Front Angle Range
Fields.Description: Angle within which the target counts as being in front. Likely in degrees.

Fields.Name: Upward Execution Threshold
Fields.Description: Upper angle limit towards the target for using this attack. Likely in degrees.

Fields.Name: Downward Execution Threshold
Fields.Description: Lower angle limit towards the target for using this attack. Likely in degrees.

Fields.Name: Is Starter Attack
Fields.Description: If ON, this attack is a starter: it can open a combo.

Fields.Name: Select Outside Optimal Distance
Fields.Description: If ON, the attack can be selected when the target is outside the optimal distance.

Fields.Name: Optimal Distance: Minimum
Fields.Description: Minimum distance to the target at which this attack is suitable. Likely in metres.

Fields.Name: Optimal Distance: Maximum
Fields.Description: Maximum distance to the target at which this attack is suitable. Likely in metres.

Fields.Name: Optimal Angle 1: Base Direction
Fields.Description: Reference direction of the first optimal angle range. Likely in degrees.

Fields.Name: Optimal Angle 1: Range
Fields.Description: Angle range around base direction 1 in which this attack is suitable. Likely in degrees.

Fields.Name: Optimal Angle 2: Base Direction
Fields.Description: Reference direction of the second optimal angle range. Likely in degrees.

Fields.Name: Optimal Angle 2: Range
Fields.Description: Angle range around base direction 2 in which this attack is suitable. Likely in degrees.

Fields.Name: Execution Interval
Fields.Description: Interval before this attack can be executed again. Likely in seconds.

Fields.Name: Selection Rate
Fields.Description: Base rate at which this attack is selected.

Fields.Name: Selection Rate: Short Range
Fields.Description: Selection rate when the target is at short range.

Fields.Name: Selection Rate: Middle Range
Fields.Description: Selection rate when the target is at middle range.

Fields.Name: Selection Rate: Long Range
Fields.Description: Selection rate when the target is at long range.

Fields.Name: Selection Rate: Out of Range
Fields.Description: Selection rate when the target is out of range.

Fields.Name: Derived Attack 1
Fields.Description: Attack ID of a follow-up attack that can be derived from this one.

Fields.Name: Goal Lifetime: Minimum
Fields.Description: Minimum lifetime of the AI goal that runs this attack. Likely in seconds.

Fields.Name: Goal Lifetime: Maximum
Fields.Description: Maximum lifetime of the AI goal that runs this attack. Likely in seconds.

Fields.Name: Select Within Optimal Distance
Fields.Description: If ON, the attack can be selected when the target is within the optimal distance.

Fields.Name: Use as First Strike
Fields.Description: If ON, the attack can be used as the first strike when combat starts.

Fields.Name: Select When Target Is Down
Fields.Description: If ON, the attack can be selected while the target is down.

Fields.Name: Arrival Distance: Minimum
Fields.Description: Minimum distance used to judge that the approach has arrived. Likely in metres.

Fields.Name: Arrival Distance: Maximum
Fields.Description: Maximum distance used to judge that the approach has arrived. Likely in metres.

Fields.Name: Combo Execution Distance
Fields.Description: Distance within which a follow-up (combo) attack is executed. Likely in metres.

Fields.Name: Combo Execution Angle
Fields.Description: Angle within which a follow-up (combo) attack is executed. Likely in degrees.
